keyword: is the stock market closed today?

verifications.claim: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq are closed Good Friday, April 3, 2026.'; R2: 'the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq — will be closed on Friday, April 3, in observance of the Christian holiday.'; R3: 'United States stock markets will be closed on Friday, April 3, in observance of Good Friday'; R4: 'The U.S. stock market is closed today, Friday, April 3, 2026, as the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq observe Good Friday'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on April 3, 2026, for Good Friday.

verifications.claim: There will be no regular trading sessions for the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) on Friday, April 3, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq are closed Good Friday, April 3, 2026.'; R2: 'the two major U.S. stock exchanges — the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq — will be closed on Friday, April 3'; R3: 'U.S. stock markets will be closed on Friday, April 3'; R4: 'major U.S. equities exchanges halt all trading'
verifications.reasoning: Full closure implies no regular trading sessions, directly supported by references stating markets are closed.

verifications.claim: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen for regular hours on Monday, April 6, 2026.
